name: WL 17

paper.title: Grain Growth and Dust Segregation Revealed by Multi-wavelength Analysis of the Class I Protostellar Disk WL 17

images.credit: Gulick et al. 2021, Fig. 1 (crop: 100 GHz panel)

paper.title: Detection of Substructures in Young Transition Disk WL 17

notes: Class I protostar in the rho Ophiuchus (L1688) molecular cloud. ALMA Band 7 (0.87mm; Han+2023) and Band 3 (3.1mm; Gulick+2021) reveal different disk substructures (an off-center hole in Band 7, a central symmetric hole in Band 3) and a low mean spectral index (alpha=2.28+/-0.02), suggestive of grain growth and dust segregation on the protostellar-disk scale; the disk may be massive and gravitationally unstable, possibly forming a single Jupiter-mass protoplanet. Distance of 137 pc adopted as the mean distance to the L1688 region.
